panels.title: Runtime Source And Mode
panels.query: latest source_sha, release_id, config_mode, provider_mode by service_key; alert on mismatch

panels.title: Public Landing And Signup Funnel
panels.query: p50/p75/p95 http duration by public_signup plus signup_funnel_total by funnel_step and outcome

panels.title: CRM List And Detail
panels.query: p50/p95 http duration by crm route_family, status_class counts, synthetic CRM result state

panels.title: Outbox Queue And Delivery
panels.query: queue depth, oldest pending age bucket, retry count, dead letter count by worker_queue and provider_family

panels.title: Auth, MFA, Parent, Student, And Class Launch
panels.query: auth_failures_total by auth_step and failure_class; portal_readiness_state by portal_surface

panels.title: Async BNA Support Bridge
panels.query: support_bridge_events_total by support_state, bna_support_mode, outcome; cached consumer state
